description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier skilled nursing facility in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential opportunity offers a competitive salary range of $115,000 - $145,000 per year, reflecting the importance of this leadership role.

As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and success of the facility, ensuring high-quality patient care, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance. This is an excellent chance for a visionary leader to make a significant impact within a supportive environment. We are looking for a professional who is passionate about enhancing the lives of residents and fostering a positive work culture.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience in skilled nursing facility administration
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care
Demonstrated leadership, management, and communication skills

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Registered Nurse (RN) to serve as an MDS Coordinator at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Missouri Valley, IA. This vital full-time role involves overseeing the Minimum Data Set (MDS) process, ensuring accurate and timely assessments that are crucial for resident care planning and facility reimbursement.

As an MDS Coordinator, you will play a key role in interdisciplinary team meetings, collaborating with various departments to develop comprehensive care plans. Your expertise will ensure compliance with federal and state regulations, contributing significantly to the quality of care provided to our residents.

This position offers an annual salary range of $65,000 - $75,000, reflecting your valuable skills and experience. We are looking for a long-term commitment and are not considering interim candidates for this opportunity.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2 years of experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility
Thorough understanding of the RAI process, Medicare/Medicaid regulations, and CMI
Proficiency in electronic health records (EHR) and MDS software
Strong organizational, assessment, and communication skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $65,000 - $75,000, based on experience.
